implementation.targetScope: The bind, memoize and debounce function API and legacy method decorators used by Redoc. No runtime dependencies.

source: Written independently from public documentation, type declarations and behavioral probes. No upstream runtime code copied.
changes: Memoizing __proto__ stores a real own cache entry without changing the supplied cache prototype.
Delayed callbacks retire pending state before invocation so exceptions do not disable the wrapper and recursive calls schedule the next window.
Declarations cover the documented function API and actual option objects; no Babel runtime is required.

caller.verified: Unchanged HistoryService and ScrollService in Chrome; no application adoption claim.
